$comment: Reference/inspiration cards for the media showroom (/social/media). Curated by hand or by a session: sourceUrl is the canonical value (never hotlink competitor images — links rot and leak referrers); note says what to steal; thumb is an optional small local file under public/social/media/refs/. assetType comes from src/components/root/social/showroom/taxonomy.ts.

references.title: Thmanyah — ثمانية
references.note: The style north star — the maker of the house typeface. Minimal Arabic typographic lockups: one thought per card, Serif Display headlines, generous space, no decoration the type doesn't earn.

references.title: Al Jazeera Technology
references.note: Arabic tech-media cards at volume: copy-centric graphics, strong typographic hierarchy, consistent brand frame — proof the template lane scales to a daily cadence.

references.title: PowerSchool
references.note: The enterprise K-12 standard: corporate blue/green gradients, sharp geometric grids, polished teacher-with-tablet lifestyle photography. What 'authoritative' looks like to district buyers.

references.title: Classter
references.note: Asymmetrical layouts with feature-spotlight vector badges (Admissions, Billing, LMS) floating around a central hero — the module-ecosystem story told in one frame.

references.title: Gradelink
references.note: Small private/charter/faith schools: social-proof testimonial lockups plus plain UI screenshots — 'No Tech Skills Required'. Trust over polish.

references.title: Alma SIS
references.note: Modern minimal duotone — deep purple + bright orange, flat design, high contrast. Aimed at forward-thinking administrators; closest to our own restraint.

references.title: Classe365
references.note: Flat, high-contrast product mockups for tech-savvy private schools — UI screenshots framed as the hero, minimal supporting copy.

references.title: OpenEduCat / Fedena
references.note: The open-source pitch to IT directors: technical mockups, dashboard data-viz, cloud/security iconography. Speaks to the buyer who reads the architecture page first — our open-source story overlaps.

references.title: Meta Ad Library — school management
references.note: The live competitive feed: every active SMS ad on Meta, searchable by advertiser. Check before designing a campaign — see what the category is running this month.

references.title: Behance — social media design
references.note: Complete brand case studies and full social asset suites — for direction-setting, not single-card ideas.

references.title: Dribbble — social post shots
references.note: Bite-sized craft: color pairings, asymmetrical layouts, typography experiments. Best for stealing one move, not a system.

references.title: AdEspresso ads gallery
references.note: Curated real Facebook ads with conversion commentary — why a hierarchy or layout works, not just that it looks good.

references.title: Pinterest — infographic & grid layouts
references.note: A search engine for modular layouts and infographic structures — feed it a slide archetype name and mine variations.

references.title: Noon Academy — أكاديمية نون
references.note: Saudi edtech speaking Arabic-first to students and parents at Facebook scale: bright single-idea cards, colloquial warmth over MSA stiffness, teachers as recurring faces. The counter-register to our calm voice — steal the accessibility, not the volume.

references.title: Alef Education
references.note: UAE K-12 platform with ministry-grade trust signals: bilingual AR/EN mirrored posts, muted palette, real classrooms over stock. What institutional credibility looks like to a MENA education buyer — our B2B register.

references.title: Madrasa — مدرسة
references.note: MBRGI free Arabic e-learning: educational infographic cards at daily cadence, Arabic typographic hierarchy that stays legible at feed size. Proof Arabic copy-led cards scale — same thesis as our template lane.

references.title: Classera
references.note: The Saudi LMS incumbent: product-UI screenshots framed in brand gradients, award/partnership badges as trust currency. What schools comparing us have already seen — differentiate with restraint, not louder gradients.

references.title: Anthropic — og/social cards
references.note: The template lane's visual north star: type-led og cards, one accent illustration, Ivory/Clay/Ink discipline, no decoration the message doesn't earn. Steal the spacing and the one-accent rule; never the logomark (no implied endorsement).
